title: Egghead on the Yellow Brick Road
description: A pale woman with short black hair kneels on a yellow cobblestone path, wearing a blue crop top, denim shorts, and purple thigh-high stockings. She holds a large mallet with white and black segments while balancing a giant yellow egg with blue spots on her head.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a pale goth girl with short black hair kneeling on a yellow cobblestone road that winds through purple hills. She wears a blue ruffled crop top, denim shorts, and purple stockings with bows. She holds a large ornate mallet and balances a giant yellow egg with blue dots on her head. In the background, a bare twisted tree with text on it stands on the left, a large setting sun glows on the horizon, and a detailed gothic cathedral sits on a hill to the right. Dramatic sunset sky with orange, purple and blue clouds.
